articleTitle: Dielectric properties of foam specimens calculated on the base of VSWR and attenuation characteristics
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: In the paper the results of experimental research and calculation of the dielectric properties ε and tg δ, in microwave band 2-8.6 GHz foam specimens, which are located in sections of rectangular waveguides are presented. The calculations were made on the base of characteristics of reflection and absorption of electromagnetic waves from foam specimens.

articleTitle: Miniaturization of microstrip patch antenna by using various shaped slots for wireless communication systems
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: A novel design for miniaturization of microstrip patch antenna is presented for electronic multifunctional wireless communication systems. The proposed design consists of four horizontal slots of various lengths on the patch. Combination of U and L-Shaped slots is designed on the ground plane. Patch and the ground plane are shorted through a shorting pin. These practices increase electrical length of the antenna and reduce size of antenna up to 86%. The proposed antenna is operating on multiple bands and able to cover numerous applications. The reflection co-efficient is <; -10dB for all the desired bands. The proposed miniaturized antenna has acceptable gain for all the bands which is in the range of 3.5dBi to 6.6dBi. The impedance bandwidth of the miniaturized antenna is in the range of 50MHz to 650MHz. This type of reduced size antenna is very appropriate for use in compact devices like Cell Phone, WLAN and Laptop.

articleTitle: High frequency electromagnetic induction sensing for non-metallic ordnances detection
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: High frequency (>100 kHz) electromagnetic induction (HFEMI) sensing phenomena are investigated for nonmetallic ordnances detection and discrimination. HFEMI responses are studied using numerical and experimental data. The numerical modeling is done via the method of auxiliary sources, and data are collected using a new HEMI system, that has been developed at our lab. The comparisons between modeled and actual data are illustrated for a non-metallic 105 mm projectile.

articleTitle: Compact multiband microstrip patch antenna using defected ground structure (DGS)
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: In this paper a novel design for miniaturization of patch antenna is presented. The proposed design for the miniaturized wide band patch antenna consists of hybrid techniques of H-shaped slot on the patch and defected ground structure. Defected ground structure is formed by cutting a combination of U and L-shaped slots. Patch and the ground plane are shorted for the further size reduction. These practices increase the current distribution path accompanied by increase in electrical length of the antenna. To validate the design a reference patch antenna is designed and its performance is compared with the proposed antenna. The designed antenna is 86% smaller than the conventional patch antenna. The miniaturized antenna has gain in the range of 4dBi to 5dBi while impedance bandwidth is in the range of 105MHz to 1700MHz. This form of compact wide band antenna is appropriate for numerous wireless communication systems like cell phone, Laptop and Hyperlane.

articleTitle: Fast iterative calculation of large body mounted antenna radiation using adaptive cross approximation
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: This paper describes the application of ACA (Adaptive Cross Approximation) algorithm for acceleration of MoM solution of large scale radiation problems. System of linear equations is solved using iterative solution and ACA is used to reduce required memory for matrix storage and speed up matrix-vector-product operation. To demonstrate applicability and performance of described technique, two numerical experiments are presented: a) calculation of radiation pattern of Magellan spacecraft high gain reflector antenna operating at 3GHz and b) calculation of radiation pattern of Wi-Fi antenna mounted on the roof of the vehicle, operating at 5.9GHz frequency. We show that ACA calculation is much faster than direct solution, while accuracy is quite acceptable.

articleTitle: Comparing different approaches to linear antenna synthesis problems according to power radiation pattern
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The antenna synthesis problem according to the prescribed power radiation pattern with the equality norm condition is solved by the approach based on the concept of generating polynomials. The variational formulation, supplied by the Lagrange method of multipliers, is applied. The modified Newton method is used for numerical solving of the respective integro-transcendental equation systems. The approach was numerically tested on the example of the antenna synthesis problem, recently solved directly by the Newton method. Numerical results are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Nonlinear three-parametric spectral problems in the synthesis theory of radiating systems with a flat aperture
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Numerical method for solving the nonlinear three-parametric spectral problems arising, in particular, in the nonlinear antenna synthesis theory with a flat radiating aperture is considered. Numerical algorithms for finding the connected components of the spectrum of linear homogeneous two-dimensional integral equations describing the bifurcation surface of solutions of synthesis problems of flat antenna according to the prescribed requirements to energy directivity pattern are constructed and justified.

articleTitle: SH-wave scattering by elastic inclusion with a thin interface layer of low rigidity
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: An analytical-numerical method is offered to study the stationary wave fields in unbounded elastic medium, scattered by elastic fibre with interfacial layer of variable thickness and low stiffness. An elastic system is under conditions of longitudinal shear. An algorithm of study is based on the modified null-field method. The influence of mechanical and geometric parameters of composite on the amplitude-frequency characteristics of SH-waves scattered by a fibre of noncanonical shape into a far zone is analyzed.

articleTitle: The possibility of using the fractional-rational approximation to determine the parameters of closely spaced resonances
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The paper discusses the problem of determining the parameters of closely spaced resonances. The overlapping ratio was introduced for estimation of the degree of the resonance peaks overlapping and analysis of its dependence against the width and magnitude of the peaks. The dependence of the error of poles estimation against the degree of resonance peaks overlapping was examined. The limits of applicability of the method of fractional-rational approximation by continued fractions were determined for two coupled resonators.

articleTitle: Solution of double-sided boundary value problems for the Laplacian in R3 by means of potential theory methods
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: A survey of conditions of well-posed solvability for the main double-sided boundary value problems for the Laplacian in R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and equivalent to them integral equations for the sum of simple and double layer potentials are given.

articleTitle: Recurrent expressions for valuing reliability indicators of complicated electromagnetic systems
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Main reliability indicators of complicated electromagnetic systems are examined in this paper. Recurrent expressions are worked out for the failure probability in the prescribed availability condition and for the failure frequency in the prescribed availability condition.

articleTitle: The improvement of traffic noice prediction methods by taking into concideration the amendments on acoustic waves reflection at small distances to buildings
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The article presents the experimental study effect of the close expanse observation point to buildings, which leads to a significant increase in noise level. Based on the experimental data, the correction for multiple reflections was improved.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic scattering on the double-periodic lattice, composed of passive dipoles
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: A plane E-polarized wave scattering problem on the double-periodic lattice, composed of passive dipoles, is considered. At normal incidence the problem is solved correctly - all the boundary conditions are met. Using the iterative method, an approximate value of the lattice reflection coefficient is given in an analytical expression. Numerical results and their physical analysis are represented.

articleTitle: On the radiation of charged particle in a waveguide filled with anisotropic magneto dielectric medium
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The transition radiation of charged particle moving in a waveguide with anisotropic magneto dielectric medium is considered. It is assumed that the charged particle moves with constant velocity perpendicular to the axis of a waveguide. The wave equation and the analytical expressions for the transverse-magnetic (TM) filed are obtained. The energy of transition radiation of moving charged particle is calculated. The conditions for the appearance of the Vavilov-Cherenkov radiation are found.

articleTitle: Axially-symmetric excitation of the biconical scatterers
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The problem of axial-symmetric excitation of the perfectly conducting biconical scatterers are analyzed rigorously using the analytical regularization technique. The solution is applied for far-field pattern analysis of conical monopole and finite bicone scatterer. In particular case the comparisons with known results are carried out.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic focusing of e-cross resolver of analyzer of complex reflection coefficient
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Electromagnetic model of asymmetric E-plane cross-shaped divider-resolver of analyzer of complex reflection coefficient is developed. The technique of focusing cross-shaped analyzer is offered. The proposed technique is based on correction of parameters of electromagnetic model of the six-port transducer. Sectors of ambiguous finding the complex reflection coefficient by five-port transducers are investigated.

articleTitle: New solutions to synthesis problem of plane array with hexagonal geometry
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Variational approach is applied for solving the synthesis problem of plane hexagonal array according to the prescribed power radiation pattern (RP). The mean-square deviation of the prescribed and synthesized RPs in sum with squared norm of currents in the array elements is used as criterion of optimization. The investigation of solution to the respective nonlinear equation has been carried out. The numerical results testify the effectiveness of the approach proposed.

articleTitle: Software model to MEMS data access based upon MongoDB
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: In the paper it is described the program model that enables to access and retrieve the data about microelectromechanical system component structure, the designed solution of microsystems etc.

articleTitle: Dual method of minimum spatial extent for processing of antenna measurements
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Inverse problem of radiation-sources restoration from near-field measurement data is considered. Case of data distortion by additive noise and spikes is investigated. New approach based on a concept of “spatial extent” is suggested. It states that the weighted sum of spatial extent of solution discrepancy and spatial extent of solution should be a minimum. Thus, the concept of spatial extent is used two times, namely, in an original space (which is the space of solution) and in a conjugate space (which is the space of solution discrepancy). The model of radiation sources is described by a set of ideal Hertzian dipoles. The case, when dipoles are located along a straight line, which is parallel to measurement line of electric field, and when their electric moments are perpendicular to the measurement plane, is considered. Algorithm, based on the conjugate gradient method, is proposed. Numerical simulations of direct and inverse problems are presented.

articleTitle: Hybridization of Mitzner approach for adaptive EM treating of combined geometries including arbitrary shape thin 3D material sheets
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Mitzner approach is hybridized on combined geometries, composed of metals, dielectrics, wires and arbitrary shape thin 3D material sheets. It is also extended to low frequency range using the loop-star approach. The developed approach is validated by comparison of simulated results for particular geometries with those obtained by other approaches. Then, it is applied for analysis of practical problems on mixed geometries, such as wireless power transmission, or inductive charging, in electrical vehicles (EV) and hybrid vehicles (HV).

articleTitle: Solution of the jump boundary value problems with additional internal and external conditions for the Laplacian in R3
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Conditions of well-posed solution of integral equations for the sum of simple and double layer potentials equivalent to the jump boundary value problems with additional Dirichlet and Neumann conditions for the Laplacian in R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> are determined.

articleTitle: Generalization of an integro-transcendetnal equation system with vanishing solutions in free phase problem
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The nonlinear integral equation of Hammerstein type with the linear dependence of the argument of unknown function and nonlinear dependency on its modulus is considered. Solutions of this equation are represented by means of polynomials of finite degree describing, in particular, zeros of these solutions. For the case of solutions vanishing in the considered interval, new system of integro-transcendental equation is obtained.

Author Keywords: nonlinear integral equation of Hammerstein type

articleTitle: Axially symmetric TM-wave radiation through the ring slot in the sphere-conical resonator
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The problem of radiation of the axial symmetric TM waves through the ring slot in the sphere-conical resonator is solved rigorously using the analytical regularization technique. Resonator is formed by a perfectly conducting semi-infinite conical surface with the ring slot in the wall, and with the spherical diaphragm by which one of conical sectors is closed. The slot is placed between the vertex and the diaphragm. The problem is reduced to an infinite system of linear algebraic equations (ISLAE) of the second kind which allows the solution with a given accuracy for any geometrical parameters and frequency. We analyze numerically the hemispherical resonator with conical aperture angle γ→ π /2. The dependence of the resonance modes radiation through the slot of the resonator on the geometrical parameters, as well as the features of the formation of far field patterns are investigated.

articleTitle: Antennas with rotational symmetry
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Methods of calculating flat and volume self-complementary and similar to them antennas consisting of a several metal and slot radiators are developed and described. These methods allow to define a mutual partial capacitances per unit length between the single radiators and groups of radiators, connected with each other, and a wave impedance of each antenna's variant. Flat vertical antennas, antennas located on the sides of the pyramid, conic and parabolic antennas are considered and analyzed. Recommendations on ways permitting to improve the antenna matching are presented.

articleTitle: Variants of volume self-complementary antennas
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Variants of volume self-complementary antennas (conic, parabolic et al.) are considered. Method of their analysis is described. Electrical characteristics depending on frequency are calculated and measured in models. Properties of different volume antennas are compared with each other and with properties of flat self-complementary antennas. It is shown that the volume self-complementary antennas allow operating at longer wavelengths and that increasing the generatrix length causes an improvement of the electrical characteristics.

articleTitle: Modified edge current method for high frequency scattering problems
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Optimization of high frequency antenna systems is impossible without efficient numerical method for direct calculation of antenna characteristics and radiated fields. Over the past 40-50 years, research in the field of high-frequency (HF) wave scattering from various objects with complex geometry and material filling, was focused on development of the methods accounting diffraction effects on the edges accurately, using high-frequency asymptotic techniques, such as Keller's Geometrical Theory of Edge Diffraction (GTD), Physical Theory of Diffraction (PTD), method of Physical Optics (PO) and the Method of Equivalent Currents (MEC). It can be shown, that these methods usually generate the most simple calculation formulas, but give inaccurate results outside backscattering direction. This paper proposes a hybrid method based on MoM, PO and modified MEC, which takes into account contribution of electric and magnetic edge currents, calculated using method of Induced Electromotive Force (EMF), into the scattered field. It is shown that, in contrast to the methods outlined above, the values of proposed edge currents are independent on the direction of radiation.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic wave scattering by a small impedance body of an arbitrary shape
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: It is proved that electromagnetic wave scattering problem for a small impedance body D of an arbitrary shape is uniquely solvable and the scattered field can be found in the form e = ∇× ∫<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub> g(x, t)J(t)dt, where S is the smooth surface of the small body D, J is a tangential field on S, and g(x, t):= e<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ik|x-t|</sup>/4π|x-t|. The full field is E = E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> + e, where E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> is the incident field. The scattering amplitude is A(α, β, k) = -ζ|S|/4π √ϵ/μ [β, τ∇×E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>(O)], where the origin O is assumed to be inside D, β := x/|x|,|x| →∞, τ := τ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pq</sub> := δ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pq</sub> - 1/|S| ∫<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub> N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>(t)N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>(t)dt, α is the unit vector in the direction of the incident plane wave, ϵ and μ are dielectric and magnetic constants of the medium, and δ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">pq</sub> is the unit tensor.

articleTitle: Properties of complex parameters of five-port reflectometer with E-plane T-junctions
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The problem of creating meter of complex reflection coefficient based on the electromagnetic approach using E-plane dividers is studied. Rigorous electromagnetic model of direct and inverse problems of five-port measurements of complex reflection coefficient is derived. Frequency dependencies of model parameters are calculated. Properties of T-junctions are investigated.

articleTitle: Multifunctional nonlinear layered media by resonant scattering and generation of waves
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Nonlinear dielectrics with controllable permittivity begin to find broad applications in device technology and are subject of intense studies in the range of both radio and optical frequencies. We focus on the development of a mathematical model, an effective algorithm and a self-consistent numerical analysis of the multifunctional properties of resonant scattering and generation of oscillations by nonlinear, cubically polarizable layered structures.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of sound generation from Y junction of city roads
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Sound radiation from vehicles moving on a city roads with a Y intersection is studied. The effect of wind on the acoustic field is considered. At first, a solution to the problem for two-point noise sources moving in opposite directions along road with non-right-angle bend is found using the integral Fourier transforms over space variables and time. Inverse transforms are calculated approximately using the stationary phase method. A solution of the general problem is obtained as a superposition of many partial solutions for the case of three roads Y intersection. The numerical analysis of traffic noise characteristics is carried out for the case of the Kosynierzow Gdynskich street and Trybunalska streets junction in the town of Lodz, Poland.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic analysis of a complex structure cylindrical antenna
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: In this paper, a special constructed cylindrical-shaped antenna's electromagnetic analysis is presented, the formula for calculating the antenna's radiation characteristics is obtained and appropriate directional diagrams are plotted.

articleTitle: Diffraction of the sound wave by a finite soft (rigid) cone
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The problem of a plane acoustic wave diffraction by a finite soft (rigid) hollow cone is analyzed and numerically computed for axially symmetric case. The problem is solved in terms of the velocity potential using the mode matching technique and the analytical regularization procedure. The unknown expansion coefficients are determined from the infinite system of linear algebraic equations (ISLAE) of the second kind, which allows one to obtain the solution with the given accuracy. The numerically obtained results are compared with those known for the disk including exact and approximate solutions.

articleTitle: West messa metal mapper data inversion and classification
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: In this paper, West Messa UXO classification results are presented for cued data collected by the Metal mapper sensor. Data sets are inverted using advanced forward EMI model called the orthonormalized volume magnetic source (ONVMS) model. All data are inverted as single, two and three sources. For each inversion, targets intrinsic parameters are extracted and used in a library matching technique. Anomalies are classified as targets of interest (TOI) and clutter.

articleTitle: Antenna on the pyramid sides
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Antenna consisting of a metal and a slot radiator, whose characteristics are similar to those of volume self-complementary antennas, is considered. It is shown that the placement of the antenna on the sides of a lying pyramid (instead of a surface of rotation) permits to simplify its design. The method of its analysis is described. The results of calculation and measurements of the electrical characteristics are presented. Recommendations for improving matching are given.

articleTitle: Experimental localization of a dielectric object near a two-way line
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The main goal of this work is the construction of a special electronic devices and equipment - for perimeter physical protection. The objective of this paper is consideration of the methods, permitting quick patrolling, easy intruder detection and revealing approximation of the undesirable person to the guarded perimeter. In this paper we introduce frequency analysis of the two wire system in an open environment, where the measurements have been conducted.

articleTitle: Extension of the method of auxiliary sources for the eigenvalue problem of the Laplace operator in case of space periodic boundaries
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: This paper describes the Method of Auxiliary Sources (MAS) and its application to eigenvalue problem of Laplace operator in case of periodic boundaries. The MAS is extended by applying appropriate Green function. The extended MAS presents an alternative approach for solving quantum billiard problems in case arbitrary shaped periodic boundaries.

articleTitle: Bio heat equation modeling on macro and micro scales
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Finite Difference Time Domain (FDTD) method is successfully applied and used in variety of problems in applied electrodynamics. In this paper we present FDTD method for heat equation for classical Fourier model as well as for Cattaneo and Chen-Tzou models in micro and nano scales. Cattaneo Bio-Heat Equation for 1D case is investigated.

Author Keywords: Finite Difference Time Domain (FDTD) method, Hyperbolic Bio Heat Equation (HBHE)

articleTitle: Base station antenna's EM field distribution in the room with a human model inside
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: A mobile communication system base station's radiation interaction with a human model inside of a building is studied in this article. The inner field and its amplification by the building as a resonator are studied. The problem is solved using the Method of Auxiliary Sources with a program package, created for numerical experiments. Several cases of the human location and building wall's transparency parameters are considered and the numerical experiment results are presented.

articleTitle: Semi-asymptotic analysis of Bragg coupling on quasiperiodic impedance rod
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Phenomena of coupling of wave beam and surface wave at impedance rod with spatially oscillating parameters are theoretically considered. Used method is asymptotic with respect to smoothness parameter and is numerical with respect to perturbation amplitudes. It combines advantages of the asymptotic and numeric methods in cases of quasiperiodic structures with large number of “periods”. Obtained coupling coefficients are compared with known asymptotic expressions.

articleTitle: Effect of 55Mn NMR echo enhancement of nuclei arranged in domain walls of half-metallic Heusler compound NiMnSb in applied magnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The effect of NMR spin-echo enhancement of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">55</sup>Mn nuclei arranged in domain walls of half metal Heusler compounds NiMnSb and NiMnSi in applied dc magnetic field was observed and studied. The effect could be related with the increase of spin-spin relaxation time at application of the outer dc magnetic field related with the rearrange and disappearance of the domain wall structure in the half metallic material.

articleTitle: Recognition of wire structure characterization on its backscatter
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Work is devoted to the recognition algorithm for body made of perfectly conducting wire, on the basis of the spatial distribution of normalized power and the parameters of the polarization ellipse of the scattered electromagnetic wave. Diffraction problem is solved by the method of integral equation. Fredholm's equation of the first kind for the electric field vector with the Dirichlet boundary conditions is solved. Numerical solution of the integral equation holds the attention of his way to a system of linear algebraic equations by direct sampling. Core feature of integration is considered. The spatial distribution of the normalized reflected power, the angle of the main axis of the ellipse and the ratio of its axes for each of the bodies for certain values of the parameters has been shown.

articleTitle: Analysis of sound field on the autotraveling viaduct
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The sound radiation from vehicles moved on city road under and above a viaduct is considered. The solution of problem is obtained as superposition of solutions for cases of separate point sources moved on the different heights and in mutually perpendicular directions with taking into account of wind effect. It is the first stage of solution of general problem without consideration diffraction effects from viaduct plate. The numerical analysis of traffic noise characteristics is carried out for one of viaduct in the town of Kielce (Poland).

articleTitle: Plane wave diffraction by the layered structure of the infinite 2D periodic lattices
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Plane EM wave diffraction phenomenon for the layered structure of the infinite 2D periodic lattices using the Method of Auxiliary Sources (MAS) is studied. There are considered the cases when this structure in embedded in the free media and also inside of the dielectric layer. The lattice elements represent open and closed conductors with the small electric radius, which have the resonant properties. As a result of the multiple resonances, these structures should have interesting complex materials properties. The existence of several resonant layers will amplify these phenomena.

articleTitle: Reflection of wave beams, pulses, and packets from apodized and chirped Bragg layered structures
publicationTitle: 2014 XIXth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The time delay, space shift and widening of wave packet transmitted and reflected by structures with Bragg mirrors have been investigated. The specific structures such as Bragg mirrors, resonators, and structures with chirp variation of thickness of the “period” have been considered. The calculation has been carried out under the conditions that carrier frequency and incidence angle is in the vicinity of the Bragg resonance. Integral (mass center) and differential (group) estimates of the delay time and space shift have been compared. The conditions for the appearance of anomalous (negative) mass center delay or mass center shift (Goos-Hänchen shift) of the reflected wave packet have been determined. The shape transformations of the wave packet illuminating periodic and quasiperiodic apodized Bragg reflectors have been under consideration. Spatial apodization of permittivity contrast yields much smaller shape deformation of the transmitted wave packet upon incidence at angles and carrier frequency near the edges of reflection band, as well in Bragg reflection band, in comparison with phenomena in similar periodic structures. The values of group delay for layered structures with a small chirp variation of optical (electrical) thickness of the period along longitudinal coordinates have been experimentally obtained in microwave range.
